title: Add centralized multi-project storage integration coverage
description: Add end-to-end and regression tests that invoke wtp from repository roots, nested directories, linked worktrees, and non-Git directories while using default plus external relative and absolute wtpDir locations. Verify that multiple projects can share one store without losing their originating task metadata; cover automatic defaults, partial and full CLI overrides, update/edit preservation and clearing, detached HEAD, legacy compatibility, backward-compatible task JSON, missing/invalid config, and unchanged Trello/provider behavior. Keep environment and Git fixtures isolated and deterministic across Unix and Windows-compatible test paths.

comments.message: Started QA coverage review: inspecting the centralized storage implementation and existing tests to add isolated end-to-end/regression cases.

Added process-isolated CLI integration coverage for default, relative, and absolute storage; linked worktree and multi-project shared stores; detached/non-Git contexts; legacy create; metadata preservation/clearing; and invalid config failures. Verified with go test ./... and ./scripts/check.sh.
